promptIntent: Separate a shared original engraved trotting-pig master into a body with its head and curled tail, forelegs and hindlegs while retaining common coordinates and scale.
transforms: WebP quality 92 encoding, method 6, exact alpha. No source crop, resize, cleanup, recolouring or alpha edits. Runtime SVG applies one common uniform source-to-logical scale and centres the 1499-pixel body in the 1500-pixel stage.
composition: Hind legs, forelegs, then body. Generated-only view-box transform origins use projected visible upper-leg pivots; original scene rotation, phase, outer bounce, pause and reduced-motion rules are retained.

validation.alphaIntegrity: All three WebP alpha channels exactly match their source PNG.
validation.staticComposition: Neutral and opposing +/-24 degree poses rendered as SVG and inspected. Body covers upper joins; four hooves remain part of the unchanged leg images.
validation.browser: Pending: actual rendering, CSS pivots, animation and pause/reduced-motion in both scenes have not been browser-verified.
limitations: At extreme pose the hind leg extends outside the original 200-unit viewport; the existing generated-art overflow rule preserves it.
The tail remains part of the static body. No current pig scene animates a tail hook.
Faint low-alpha generation noise is retained without cleanup.
This is a review checkpoint, not a claim that final art or motion review is complete.

budget.class: concept-demo raster assets; outside story page budgets
budget.criticality: Requested with the demo figure markup, not newly lazy-loaded.
